SELECT top_tags.tag_name, top_tags.question_count, best.answer_id, best.question_id, best.score, best.user_id, best.creation_date
FROM (
  SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_name, COUNT(pt.post_id) AS question_count
  FROM tags t
  JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
  GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
  ORDER BY question_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
) top_tags
JOIN (
  SELECT tag_id, answer_id, question_id, score, user_id, creation_date
  FROM (
    SELECT pt.tag_id, a.post_id AS answer_id, a.parent_id AS question_id, a.score, a.user_id, a.creation_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tag_id ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.post_id) AS rn
    FROM posts_answers a
    JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.post_id = a.parent_id
    WHERE pt.tag_id IN (
      SELECT tag_id FROM (
        SELECT tag_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM post_tags GROUP BY tag_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5
      )
    )
    AND a.creation_date >= '2020-01-01'
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) best ON best.tag_id = top_tags.tag_id
ORDER BY top_tags.question_count DESC;

  JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id

  GROUP BY strftime('%Y', q.creation_date), t.tag_id, t.tag_name
)
WHERE rn = 1

GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_activity DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT tt.tag_name, tt.question_count, a.post_id AS answer_id, a.parent_id AS question_id, a.user_id, a.score, a.creation_date
FROM (
    SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_name, COUNT(pt.post_id) AS question_count
    FROM tags t
    JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
    GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
    ORDER BY question_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
) tt
JOIN (
    SELECT pt.tag_id, a.post_id, a.parent_id, a.user_id, a.score, a.creation_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.tag_id ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.post_id) AS rn
    FROM post_tags pt
    JOIN posts_answers a ON a.parent_id = pt.post_id
    WHERE pt.tag_id IN (

            SELECT tag_id, COUNT(post_id) AS c
            FROM post_tags
            GROUP BY tag_id
            ORDER BY c DESC

        )
